'''Bayungu''' (Payungu) is an [[Australian Aboriginal languages|Australian Aboriginal language]] spoken along the [[Minilya River]] in the state of [[Western Australia]] by the [[Baiyungu]] people.<ref>{{Cite journal |last=Austin |first=Peter |date=30 June 1988 |title=Aboriginal languages of the Gascoyne-Ashburton region |url=https://opal.latrobe.edu.au/articles/journal_contribution/Aboriginal_languages_of_the_Cascoyne-Ashburton_region/22201855 |journal=Working Papers in Linguistics |pages= |doi=10.26181/22201855}}</ref> There were 2 speakers in 2005.<ref name=AIATSIS />
